description:
Capital Finance is an innovative cross-chain yield aggregator designed to maximise returns on USDC deposits across multiple blockchain networks. Currently operational on Optimism and Base, our platform utilizes advanced algorithms to continuously monitor and compare yield rates, automatically moving funds to capture the highest yield opportunities. It also offers a Refer & Earn feature, allowing users to share personalized Farcaster Frames. Through this feature, users can earn commissions on all deposits made via their unique farcaster frames.

Key features include:

- Cross-chain deposits and withdrawals of USDC
- Automated yield optimization using AAVE lending protocols (with plans to integrate more)
- Secure cross-chain transfers powered by Chainlink's CCIP
- Dynamic rebalancing for maximum returns
- User-friendly interface for easy deposit, withdrawal, and yield tracking
- Affiliate program to incentivize user acquisition
how_its_made:
We have two main contracts:
CapitalFi: Handles user deposits, withdrawals, and yield optimization
CapitalFiGateway: Manages cross-chain communications

We use Chainlink's CCIP (Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol) to securely move funds and data between Optimism and Base blockchains.

 Our contracts interact with AAVE lending pools on each chain to earn yield. We compare rates across chains and move funds to get the best returns.

We use Goldsky to index the contracts and fetch the details in the front end. Our entire frontend is also available as a Farcaster Frame. Farcaster Influencers can use our platform to monetize their popularity by sharing our frames and earning affiliate fees. This way we plan to leverage Farcaster as a distribution layer.
